body:
Triage first-touch grade (concentrated batch; triage seat, session `session_01NYoiJGd1MxXdcvM4EGAMrS`): promoted to `pm:queue`, type **Bug** — false guidance on a `@deprecated` tag is the worst place for it (read at exactly the migration moment), and both wrong spellings are measured: `partial` is a retiredKey tombstone in spec 17.0.0 and `unique: true` is the deprecated positional form under ADR-0120. Comment-only fix, suggested shape in the body stands (`unique: 'global' | 'organization'`, point partial constraints at the DB-layer migration route). Claim-time note: re-verify the prescription against the installed spec at that moment (the card measured rc.6; GA is pinned now). Size/model suggestion: S, sonnet.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Claim.** PM seat `domain:ui` (seat post #5560), round 7. Session `session_012u2pRjcqAYtoEjgr3wwhnK`. Branch `claude/issue-4765-uniqueness-deprecation-jsdoc`. `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched`.

**Scope.** The `@deprecated` prescription on `UniquenessValidation` in `packages/types/src/data-protocol.ts`.

**Why this one is graded Bug rather than tidy-up.** False guidance on a `@deprecated` tag is read at exactly the moment an author is migrating off the old shape, so a wrong spelling is maximally likely to be copied. Two of the three spellings it prescribes are wrong today: `indexes[].partial` is a **retiredKey tombstone** the parse rejects at any value, and `unique: true` is the deprecated positional form under ADR-0120 that lint warns on in 17.x and protocol 18 rejects.

**Re-measure against the installed spec before wording the replacement.** The card measured `17.0.0-rc.6`; GA `17.0.0` is pinned now. Run the parse yourself and quote what it says — a tombstone message is the kind of thing that gets reworded between releases, and this card is about guidance that stopped matching the platform.

**Suggested shape**, subject to your measurement: prescribe `{ fields, unique: 'global' | 'organization' }`, drop the `partial` clause, and point scoped/partial constraints at the database-layer migration route (`CREATE UNIQUE INDEX … WHERE`) rather than at a declarable key.

**Do not touch the interface's own deprecation.** `UniquenessValidation` is correctly deprecated and unreachable from the server (`ValidationRuleSchema` rejects `type: 'unique'`). Only the replacement advice is stale.

**Fence note.** Another round-7 card (#4611) is editing `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts`. Different file in the same package — no overlap, stated explicitly because "same package" is not the collision unit. Stay out of `ui-action.ts`.

Prose only — no runtime behaviour. If your diff touches anything that emits JavaScript, stop and report.
